title: Mr Ed terminal carries the same theme control as the panel: one per-browser preference (match admin theme, light, dark) plus a colour picker, shared by the floating panel, the inline card and the full-window terminal; the terminal repaints its whole palette from the choice, so a light colour keeps every line readable

Reclaimed 11 GB on the Parrot production disk by retiring 217 staged builds older than the newest 8 (free space 45 GB to 56 GB, 80% to 76%); the served build and the 7 previous generations are kept, 0 open handles and 0 PM2 references to any removed directory

Build pipeline now keeps the newest 8 staged builds and retires older ones only after a new build is verified and answering; the served build and the newest generations are never touched, symlinks and anything not named .next-junkalot-* are never removed, and every removal is appended to data/build-retention.jsonl
